days.title: Ayllón Peaks and Beech Forests
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: pico del Lobo
stops.detail: In this relief, the highest altitudes in the province of Guadalajara are present, among which those of the Pico del Lobo (2273 m above sea level), the Cerrón (2199 m above sea level), and the Peña Cebollera Vieja or Tres Provincias (2129 m above sea level) stand out.

stops.name: Hayedo de Tejera Negra
stops.detail: It encompasses the Ayllón and Pela mountain ranges, among other smaller ones, as well as the pre-existing Hayedo de Tejera Negra natural park, the Pico del Lobo-Cebollera Massif natural reserve, the Pelagallinas River fluvial reserve, and the Sonsaz hunting reserve, among other natural spaces in the area.

days.title: Southern Karst and Dams
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Tamajón
stops.detail: The greatest development of karst morphologies takes place in the carbonate outcrops near Tamajón, where an interesting karst with a predominance of exokarstic and endokarstic forms develops.

stops.name: Pontón de la Oliva
stops.detail: The lowest point of the natural park is located in the southwest, in the vicinity of the Pontón de la Oliva dam (725 m above sea level).
